hook.onscreen: Has this exact shuffle ever happened before?
hook.voiceover: Properly shuffle a deck of cards, and you've almost certainly made history.

stories.voiceover: The first card can be any of fifty-two. The next, any of fifty-one. Then fifty. All the way down to one.
Multiply all of that, and you get roughly an eight with sixty-seven zeros behind it.
Now picture every person on Earth shuffling a deck every second, since the Big Bang.
They still wouldn't make a dent. So the order in your hands has almost certainly never existed before.
